name: Canvas Status Bar
description: Bottom status bar displaying zoom percentage with lock/unlock lock icon (clickable to toggle), workspace name, and a 'view all' button. Shows a reset-zoom icon when zoom is not 100% and unlocked. Updates via the update() method called by CanvasArea on zoom, lock, or workspace name changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates status bar DOM elements (zoom, locked, workspace, view all) inside #statusbar

methods.name: update
methods.signature: (locked: boolean, scale: number, workspaceName: string, onLockToggle: () => void, fitAll: () => void, resetZoom?: () => void): void
methods.description: Updates zoom percentage, lock icon SVG, workspace name text, visibility of reset-zoom icon
